DJ-style transitions between songs from extensions, downloads and local files: each song is analysed once (beats, bars, phrases, key) and the next one comes in on the beat, tempo matched, with a bass swap. Songs that cannot be beat-matched get a cut on the beat or a fade. Streams are analysed on unmetered networks, or on mobile data if you allow it below.
Bass swap and filters during the mix. Off, only the volumes move.
Songs in clashing keys get short mixes, matching keys long ones. Off, keys are ignored.

"AutoMix mixes the songs Spotivy plays itself: from extensions, downloads and files on this phone. Spotify songs play in Spotify's web player, whose sound the app never has: they only fade.
Each song is analysed once (beats, bars, key). Streams are analysed on Wi-Fi, or on mobile data if you allow it; a song not analysed in time changes with a fade."
Short: 4 to 8 bars. Balanced: preferably 8 to 16. Long: preferably 12 to 32, up to 90 seconds. Shorter when the music needs it.
Songs from extensions are analysed on mobile data too. Each is downloaded a second time for it: about as much data again as playing it. Off, on Wi-Fi only.

Quick mix brings the next song in from its start on the next downbeat. Real mix picks a downbeat or phrase of this song within 4 seconds and the best entry of the next one, over 4 bars with the bass swap.
